notes: 10 prototypes per role across 5 prototype-only topics. Authored before eval.json. Disjoint topic set from eval.json by construction.

decision.text: Decided to switch logging from JSON to OTLP after the schema migration cleared review.
Approved the structured-logging migration; rollout begins next sprint.
Settled on Grafana over Datadog for internal dashboards; cost was 4x lower.
Switched the SRE on-call dashboard from PagerDuty to Grafana incidents.
Adopted Bazel for the polyglot monorepo after a 2-week pilot.
Replaced the nightly CI fleet with on-demand spot instances.
Changed the code review policy: 1-approver for typo fixes, 2 for logic.
Approved the auto-merge feature for dependabot-only PRs.
Decided to move oncall rotation from weekly to daily handoffs.
Selected PagerDuty over Opsgenie for the new oncall workflow.

investigation.text: Investigating why log ingestion drops 4% of records during peak hours.
Looking into the Splunk indexer slowness on Tuesdays.
Diagnosing why the Grafana home dashboard loads slowly for new users.
Examining why SLO dashboards show different numbers from the metrics service.
Root-causing why CI builds intermittently fail at the dependency-fetch step.
Exploring whether we can shave 3 minutes off the build by parallelizing tests.
Trying to understand why bot-flagged PRs sit in review for 5+ days.
Investigating the recent uptick in self-merged PRs across the platform team.
Diagnosing the pager-fatigue trend showing up in the recent oncall surveys.
Looking into why the new oncall handoff template is being skipped in 30% of handoffs.

observation.text: Logs show roughly 12% of error events are being silently dropped at the egress proxy.
Noticed log volume tripled after the recent deploy.
Dashboard metrics show p99 latency rose from 280ms to 410ms last week.
Observed that the SRE dashboard widget for queue depth has been NaN since Tuesday.
Build logs indicate the dependency cache hit rate dropped from 92% to 78%.
Saw the CI queue back up to 80 builds during the post-lunch deploy window.
Code review metrics show median time-to-review at 1.7 days, up from 1.1 last month.
Found 3 PRs merged this week without the required test coverage.
Oncall dashboard shows page volume up 22% week-over-week.
Reports indicate the oncall response p95 is now 8 minutes vs last quarter's 4 minutes.

preference.text: Personally I'd lean toward OTLP-only logging once the migration is done.
Team's preference is to keep JSON logs for legacy services and OTLP for new ones.
We'd rather have one canonical dashboard than three role-specific ones.
Recommend Grafana over Kibana for the dashboards-as-code workflow.
Prefer Bazel hermeticity over Make convenience for the polyglot stack.
Lean toward investing in build caching over more CI hardware.
Would rather have 2-approver reviews on auth-touching code, even at velocity cost.
My preference is async review over synchronous pair-review for non-urgent PRs.
In favor of moving to a follow-the-sun oncall once we have EU coverage.
Recommend keeping primary plus secondary oncall structure even after the team grows.
